title: Set 296

sentences.ko: 먼저 가서 정말 미안한데, 베이비시터한테 10시까지 들어간다고 했거든. 또 늦으면 이제 진짜 두 배로 받을 거야.
sentences.text: I'm really sorry to bail early, but I told the babysitter I'd be back by ten, and if I'm late again she's going to start charging me double.

alts.text: Sorry I gotta run, I told the sitter I'd be home by ten, and if I'm late again she's gonna start charging me double.
I do apologize for leaving early, but I told the babysitter that I would be home by ten, and if I am late again, she will begin charging me double.

sentences.note: **bail early** 는 모임에서 일찍 빠져나간다는 뜻의 편한 말입니다. **charging me double** 은 나한테 두 배로 받는다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 저녁 모임에서 먼저 일어날 구실 만들기

sentences.ko: 캠핑을 갔는데 내내 비가 와서, 결국 텐트 안에서 새벽 두 시쯤까지 카드놀이만 했어. 근데 솔직히 날씨 좋았으면 이만큼 재밌진 않았을 것 같아.
sentences.text: We went camping, but it rained the whole time, so we ended up playing cards in the tent until like two in the morning. And honestly, I think it was more fun than if the weather had been nice.

alts.text: Went camping and it poured the whole time, so we just played cards in the tent till like two a.m. Honestly? Kinda more fun than if it'd been nice out.

We went camping, but it rained the entire time, so we ended up playing cards in the tent until about two in the morning. To be honest, I believe it was more enjoyable than it would have been in good weather.

sentences.note: **ended up** 은 계획과 달리 결국 ~하게 됐다는 뜻입니다. **the whole time** 은 처음부터 끝까지 내내라는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 이번엔 설탕 안 먹고 11일 버텼어. 내 최고 기록이야. 근데 누가 사무실에 도넛을 사 온 거야. 반 개만 먹자고 마음먹었는데, 어떻게 됐을지 알지?
sentences.text: I made it eleven days without sugar this time, which is a record for me. But then somebody brought donuts into the office, and I told myself I'd just have half of one, and you can guess how that went.

alts.text: Eleven days, no sugar, a new record for me! Then someone brought donuts to work, I was like, okay, just half, and yeah, you know how that went.

This time I managed eleven days without sugar, which is a personal record. However, a colleague then brought donuts into the office, and I told myself I would have only half of one. I am sure you can imagine how that turned out.

sentences.note: **made it eleven days** 는 11일을 버텼다, 해냈다는 뜻입니다. **you can guess how that went** 는 결과가 뻔했다는 걸 웃으며 말할 때 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 잘 돼요. 다만 미리 말씀드리면, 소리를 끝까지 올리면 왼쪽 스피커가 가끔 끊겨요. 보통 소리로 들으시면 아마 모르실 거예요. 그래서 30달러만 받는 거예요.
sentences.text: It works fine, I just want to be upfront that the left speaker cuts out sometimes if you turn it all the way up. So if you mostly listen at a normal volume, you'll probably never notice, but that's why I'm only asking thirty for it.

alts.text: Works fine, just so you know, the left speaker cuts out sometimes if you crank it all the way up. If you mostly keep it at normal volume you probably won't even notice, but that's why I'm only asking thirty.

It works properly, but I should mention that the left speaker occasionally cuts out at maximum volume. If you usually listen at a normal volume, you will most likely never notice, but that is the reason I am asking only thirty for it.

sentences.note: **be upfront** 는 숨기지 않고 미리 솔직하게 말한다는 뜻입니다. **cuts out** 은 소리나 신호가 잠깐씩 끊긴다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 과학 박람회 메일 받았어? 올해는 애들이 실제로 작동하는 걸 만들어야 한대. 딸 자는 동안 나 자정까지 이것저것 붙이고 있을 게 벌써 뻔해.
sentences.text: Did you get that email about the science fair? They want the kids to build something that actually works this year, so I already know I'm going to be up until midnight gluing stuff together while my daughter's asleep.

alts.text: You see that science fair email? They want the kids to build stuff that actually works this year, so yeah, I'm gonna be up till midnight gluing things while my daughter's asleep.

Did you receive the email regarding the science fair? This year they would like the children to build something that actually works, so I already expect to be up until midnight gluing things together while my daughter is asleep.

sentences.note: **be up until midnight** 는 자정까지 안 자고 깨어 있다는 뜻입니다. **gluing stuff together** 는 이것저것 풀로 붙인다는 편한 말입니다.

reviewed: 1번 한국어 '두 배로 받기 시작할 거야'는 영어 start charging 을 그대로 옮긴 번역투라 '이제 진짜 두 배로 받을 거야'로 고침
2번 한국어 '날씨 좋았을 때보다 더 재밌었던 것 같아'는 영어의 가정(if the weather had been nice)과 어긋나고 어색해서 '날씨 좋았으면 이만큼 재밌진 않았을 것 같아'로 고침
2번 casual 이 So 로 시작하고 바로 뒤에 so 가 또 나와 겹쳐서 앞의 So 를 뺌
4번 formal 'I would like to be honest that' 은 원어민이 쓰지 않는 구조라 'I should mention that' 으로 고침
